newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent slides in line with NYMEX losses.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent slides in line with NYMEX losses.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices in Asia fell slightly on Tuesday, pulled lower by extended profit taking on NYMEX.
July Brent crude was last traded on SIMEX at $20.10 per barrel, down six cents from London's settlement overnight. Volume was just 164 lots.
July NYMEX crude, trading on the after-hours ACCESS system, was last traded at $21.82 per barrel, down eight cents from New York's close.
Brokers said Brent's losses were in line with the losses on NYMEX.
They said technically Brent for July was likely to be supported around $20.01 -- a 50-percent retracement of the rally on Friday which took the contract as high as $20.60.
